gates: Verify Eval on a Stream preview; distribution/sketch serialization and Datadog acceptance must pass before enabling

proposedFunction.filter: typeof sketch !== 'undefined' && sketch != null && sketch.metric === "istio.mesh.request.duration.milliseconds" && Array.isArray(sketch.tagsList) && sketch.tagsList.includes("kube_namespace:istio-system")
proposedFunction.description: Pilot draft: edit only sketch.tagsList in Datadog-only output pipeline; retain all sketch points

attach: Append after review to the Datadog-only pipeline on datadog-agent-intake → ifood-sandbox-datadog. Preserve existing health-prune functions. Do not use the common input pipeline or replace the source connections.
retain: Leave datadog-agent-intake → ifood_datadog without this transformation. Query original sketches in Cribl Search dataset ifood_datadog.
originalDetailQuery:
dataset="ifood_datadog"
| where tostring(sketch.metric) == "istio.mesh.request.duration.milliseconds"
| where tostring(sketch.tagsList) contains "\"kube_namespace:istio-system\""
| project _time, metric=sketch.metric, host=sketch.host, tags=sketch.tagsList, dogsketches=sketch.dogsketchesList, distributions=sketch.distributionsList
| limit 101
rollback: Disable/remove only the new Eval and restore the saved Datadog-only pipeline revision. Keep Lake unchanged; verify original tag coverage resumes.
validation: Capture immutable pipeline/source revision and same-window baseline before approval
Preview: only exact metric + original scope changes; nonpilot events unchanged; dogsketchesList/distributionsList deep-equal; cnt/kList/nList/ts/min/max/sum retained
Verify native fan-out isolation: the Datadog-only transformation must not mutate tags or points in the original Lake branch
Compare distinct metric + host + canonical remaining tags before/after on a matching pilot window
Measure real compressed/uncompressed outbound bytes from Datadog destination; tag-array JSON-byte simulation is not outbound volume
Compare Datadog-reported ingested/indexed volume with correct lookback and billing terms; do not infer savings from combinations

Validate original and transformed copies of the same capture in isolated baseline/pilot canary metrics or a test org after verifying serialization; compare sum(cnt), point counts, p95 and p99 over identical timestamps and retained dimensions. Colliding tag sets must merge without last-write sample loss. Do not double-send the same production metric or average sketch percentiles
Replay linked monitors/dashboards/variables and obtain owner sign-off; stop and roll back on missing data, percentiles outside approved tolerance, or delivery errors
